{{Top|leg}}
The '''Dorja family''' was a wealthy family<ref name="CSWE Captain Dorja">{{CSWECite|I|200|Dorja, Captain}}</ref> of whom eight straight generations served the [[Navy/Legends|navy]] of either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], or [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]].<ref name="DFR Sourcebook ">''[[Dark Force Rising Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="Destiny's Way chapter ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Destiny's Way]]''</ref>

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dorja]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] was the seventh Dorja [[Gender/Legends|man]] to serve&mdash;his [[Dorja's father|father]], [[Dorja's grandfather|grandfather]], and the preceding generations had all been naval [[Officer/Legends|officers]]. At least one of his ancestors was an [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]], and more than one commanded a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] of the line. Dorja became the captain of the Galactic Empire's [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] before the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="DFR Sourcebook " /> and, after the Empire ceased to exist in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]],<ref name="Atlas ">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> he continued to command the [[Warship/Legends|warship]] in [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] Imperial Remnant.<ref name="CSWE Captain Dorja" /> His daughter, [[Vana Dorja|Vana]],<ref name="CSWE Vana">{{CSWECite|I|200|Dorja, Commander Vana}}</ref> followed in her [[Parent/Legends|father's]] footsteps and became a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the Remnant's Navy.<ref name="Destiny's Way chapter " />
